description: Third export from the experiment server: Phase 10 (DINOv3 views, VLM base detectors and the streaming configuration on the OpenOOD v1.5 ImageNet-1K and Four-OOD streams) and Phase 11 (the post-stream two-sided read-out that the paper calls Salmon Ladder: sweeps 11, 11b-11e and the final run). Every file listed under 'files' was exported byte-identical to the server file; its sha256 was computed on the server.
files_note: server_mtime_utc is the modification time of the file on the server (clock in UTC), read at export.

per_stream_tables_of_sweep_e.reason: per-stream metric tables of the weight sweep 11e (14.8 MB); the aggregated p11e_summary.json and p11e_table.txt are archived

not_archived_note: feature arrays (features/*.npy), caches, per-image score files (results/**/*.npz, *.pt) and logs larger than 4 MB are not exported (size); per-stream metric tables, aggregated JSON files and the analysis logs are. The per-stream metric tables of sweep 11e were exported but are not archived (size); their aggregate is.
